event_description: Fired when a user successfully submits the registration form.
Fired when a user successfully logs in via the login form.
Fired when a user requests a password reset by submitting their email.
Fired when a user successfully verifies their email with the verification code.
Fired when a user successfully resets their password after verification.
Fired when a user successfully updates their profile information.
Fired when a user successfully changes their account password.
Fired when a user clicks to open a chat with a contact.
Fired when a user sends a message in a chat conversation.
Fired when a user opens the info panel for a specific contact.
